Home.eyebrow: University of Tokyo General Library Collection
Home.title: Explore print culture from the late Edo to Taisho periods, one pasted item at a time.
Home.lead: This experimental digital exhibition lets you search across all 96 volumes of Kunshujo with enriched metadata such as people, places, object detection, and extracted colors.
Home.aboutDescription: Learn the background of Kunshujo and this extended digital exhibition.
Home.exampleDescription: Start with curated examples by topic.
Home.otherSearchDescription: Search items other than pasted materials.
Home.siteDescriptionLong: This system is a digital exhibition site centered on searching and browsing the Kunshujo collection held by the University of Tokyo General Library. It also implements experimental data displays using machine learning.
